title: A Frappe on_submit server script is enough to record the submitted business event outside the ERP
content:
The ERPNext demo uses a Frappe server script hooking on_submit for Sales Invoice, dispatching a typed operation into Powerhouse. Submission is the right boundary because it is where the paired fit finding locates the business event — the moment the document stops being a draft and becomes an assertion the organisation stands behind.

The demonstration then deletes the ERPNext record and replays it from Powerhouse. Against an ERP this is a pointed choice: the invoice is the canonical example of a record whose disappearance is a compliance problem rather than an inconvenience, so the replay answers a question the audience already has to answer for their own customers.

Three leads carry this demo — ALYF, K&K Software and phamos, all German — and all three are marked "1 · start here". That makes it the only tool cohort in this slice with unanimous top priority, and it pairs a fully specified integration point with an audience that is already qualified in.
